verses.text: After Jesus had said this, he looked up towards heaven and prayed: "Father, the time has come. Bring glory to your Son, so that your Son may bring glory to you.
You gave him authority over all people, so that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.
And this is eternal life: to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.
I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.
And now, Father, give me glory in your presence, the glory I had with you before the world began.
I have shown what you are like to the people you gave me out of the world. They were yours, and you gave them to me, and they have obeyed your word.
Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
I gave them the message you gave me, and they accepted it. They know for certain that I came from you, and they believe that you sent me.
I am praying for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, because they are yours.
All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.

I will not stay in the world any longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them safe by the power of your name, the name you gave me, so that they may be one, just as we are one.

While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power of your name, the name you gave me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost except the one who was headed for destruction, so that the Scripture would come true.
Now I am coming to you. But I am saying these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have my joy completely in their hearts.
I have given them your word, and the world has hated them, because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.
I am not asking you to take them out of the world, but to protect them from the evil one.
They do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to it.
Make them holy by your truth. Your word is truth.
Just as you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.
For their sake I give myself completely to you, so that they too may be made holy by the truth.
I am not praying only for them. I am also praying for everyone who will believe in me because of their message.
I pray that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us, so that the world will believe that you sent me.
I have given them the glory that you gave me, so that they may be one, just as we are one:
I in them and you in me. May they be brought into perfect unity. Then the world will know that you sent me, and that you have loved them just as you have loved me.
Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am. I want them to see my glory, the glory you gave me because you loved me before the world was made.
Righteous Father, the world does not know you, but I know you, and these people know that you sent me.
I have made you known to them, and I will keep on making you known. Then the love you have for me will be in them, and I myself will be in them."
